subject: MLB Manager of the Year voting
query: how is mlb manager of the year voted
title: How is MLB Manager of the Year voted? 2026: Venable and Murphy
answer: MLB's Manager of the Year is voted on by 30 members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America in each league, two from each city. Each ranks three managers, worth 5, 3 and 1 points, before the postseason begins. The 2026 winners, announced Nov. 10, were Will Venable of the White Sox and Pat Murphy of the Brewers.
body:
Because ballots are due before the playoffs, a manager's postseason run does not count. Writers in American League cities vote on the AL award and writers in National League cities on the NL award. A voter may not split a spot between two managers, and full ballots have been published online since 2012.

In the American League, Venable won with 15 first-place votes and 111 points, ahead of Kevin Cash of the Rays (98 points) and Chad Tracy of the Red Sox (47). His White Sox went 84-78 and reached the playoffs a year after a 60-102 season. In the National League, Murphy took 20 first-place votes and 124 points, ahead of Walt Weiss of the Braves (86) and Don Mattingly of the Phillies (25). It was Murphy's third straight award, the first time a manager has won three years in a row, after the Brewers won a franchise-record 103 games.

Manager of the Year was the BBWAA's newest award until 2026, when the writers added Relief Pitcher of the Year.
in_the_news: Will Venable of the White Sox and Pat Murphy of the Brewers won the 2026 Manager of the Year awards on Nov. 10, 2026; Murphy became the first manager to win three straight.

faq.a: Will Venable of the Chicago White Sox in the AL and Pat Murphy of the Milwaukee Brewers in the NL, announced Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026.

faq.q: Who were the 2026 Manager of the Year finalists?
faq.a: AL: Kevin Cash, Chad Tracy, Will Venable. NL: Don Mattingly, Pat Murphy, Walt Weiss.

faq.q: Has anyone won Manager of the Year three years in a row?
faq.a: Pat Murphy is the first, winning the NL award in 2024, 2025 and 2026.

faq.q: Does the postseason count for Manager of the Year?
faq.a: No. Voters submit ballots before the postseason starts.
